_meta.batch: Examine - Puzzle misc (43 terminy) - koncowe fragmenty mechanik zagadek: aktywacja Zelaznego Dzwonu nad Kotlem (BellCauldron), zawartosc Czarnej Skrzynki (BlackBox: koperta zalobna, szpula filmowa, zwoj), oraz ujawnienie projektora ukrytego w lalce Symmetry (LifesizeDoll).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.en: [i]Ahh - I can't quite reach both handles at the same time.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.pl: [i]Ach - nie mogę dosięgnąć obu uchwytów naraz.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.en:
Because there's two of us.
We can take one handle each.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.pl:
Bo jest nas dwoje.
Możemy wziąć po jednym uchwycie.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.en: You know, you don't [h]have[/h] to stand there with your face pressed into it.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.pl: Wiesz, nie [h]musisz[/h] stać z twarzą wciśniętą w to.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron CantReach/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Initial/Se.en: So when the Iron Bell is placed over the cauldron, it can be used to lock or unlock the lid...
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Initial/Se.pl: Więc kiedy Żelazny Dzwon zostanie umieszczony nad kotłem, można go użyć, żeby zablokować albo odblokować pokrywę...
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Initial/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Initial/Se.en: It [i]could[/i] - if we can work out how to activate it.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Initial/Se.pl: [i]Mógłby[/i] - jeśli uda nam się rozgryźć, jak go aktywować.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Initial/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.en: But there's something in [i]particular[/i] I think we should take a look at.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.pl: Ale jest coś [i]konkretnego,[/i] czemu myślę, że powinniśmy się przyjrzeć.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.en: The top part spun around - that [i]mechanism[/i] - it was really fast.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.pl: Górna część się obróciła - ten [i]mechanizm[/i] - był naprawdę szybki.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.en: So that's how you unlock the cauldron...
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved bg/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved fra.en: That little metal part isn't supposed to be there, huh.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved fra.pl: Ta mała metalowa część nie powinna tam być, co nie.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BellCauldron Solved fra.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_Envelope 2/Sec.en: It's used to send news of someone's death.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_Envelope 2/Sec.pl: Używa się jej do przekazywania wiadomości o czyjejś śmierci.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_Envelope 2/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_Sound/Section.en:
[i]It slides out at the side.
Let me do it.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_Sound/Section.pl:
[i]Wysuwa się z boku.
Daj, ja to zrobię.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_Sound/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_exit/Section d.en: There's no way to open it.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_exit/Section d.pl: Nie ma sposobu, żeby to otworzyć.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_exit/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_exit/Section d.en: Maybe there [h]is[/h] a way to open it after all.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_exit/Section d.pl: Może jednak [h]jest[/h] jakiś sposób, żeby to otworzyć.
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_exit/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_scroll 2/Secti.en: Should we put it back together?
Examine/Exam_Puz_BlackBox_scroll 2/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Puz_LifesizeDoll Projector.en: Sorry - [i]why[/i] was there a projector hidden inside the doll?
Examine/Exam_Puz_LifesizeDoll Projector.pl: Przepraszam - [i]czemu[/i] w lalce był ukryty projektor?
Examine/Exam_Puz_LifesizeDoll Projector.speaker: Sally
